body.en: “Measures” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. Part type on the page is an S-tube large-end and small-end seal kit. Unit: set. φ100 is a small-end seal kit. It is not the 100 / 125 mm pipe cell. Material is a missing field. Service life is a missing field. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The S-tube seal page does not point to Electric 20, HBT8018, LZ-60 or any other model slug. The outline does not complete a blank.

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “Hardening”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write S-tube small-end seal, φ100, and the quantity in sets. For φ220, say whether the six-piece kit is the row you checked on the machine. For other large-end sizes, do not add a six-piece count. The φ100 small-end seal is one kit row on the Xingtai S-tube seal page. Large-end rows are φ210, φ220 and φ250. Small-end rows are φ80, φ90, φ100 and φ105. This note is the φ100 small-end row only. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
